title: Tool call (adapter input, neuroverse-governance/1)
description: What the enforcing adapter takes from a model: a tool call in the OpenAI shape ({ id?, function: { name, arguments } }) or the plain shape ({ name, args }). SPEC.md § 16.9. The adapter parses `arguments` when it is a string; arguments that are not JSON, or not an object, are refused and never run.
